findings: Together public fine-tuning documentation checked on 2026-08-22 lists no Qwen2/Qwen2.5 training base.
The old implicit Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-Turbo value is inference-visible but is not documented as a current fine-tuning base; inference visibility is not training-template evidence.
Together BYOM requires architecture compatibility between the external Hugging Face checkpoint and selected Together base/template.
Together estimate-price does not accept from_hf_model or hf_model_revision, so it cannot establish checkpoint compatibility.
Together create and the current Python SDK accept hf_model_revision, allowing exact source checkpoint pinning.

Current-main campaign identity and local create-intent ledger did not bind hf_model_revision and relied on an implicit template default; this delta closes those identity gaps without weakening paid-create safety.

unusual_experiment.name: template_mirage_qwen35_08b_substitution
unusual_experiment.counter_reality: Use the documented Qwen3.5-0.8B full-FT base as the template for Qwen2.5-0.5B because vendor family and size are close.
unusual_experiment.reason: Architecture/model-generation mismatch; parameter-count proximity cannot satisfy BYOM architecture matching.
unusual_experiment.regression_note: Existing ambiguous-create fault tests from prior parallel go work are regression-only and do not count as a second unusual experiment here.

pinned primary and ablation Hugging Face revisions
campaign fingerprint schema v2 binds checkpoint revision and explicit template
local create-intent schema v2 stores the same exact campaign descriptor

current_blocker: No currently documented Qwen2/Qwen2.5 Together full-fine-tuning template is available. A credentialed current model_limits/create admission is required before Together compatibility can be claimed.
next_discriminator: Require exact-checkout PR corpus and launcher-safety PASS. Then, only with TOGETHER_API_KEY mounted in an authorized execution environment and a currently verified Qwen2-compatible template name, run non-billed preflight. If no Qwen2-compatible Together template exists, retain Qwen2.5-0.5B and change only the training runner rather than silently pivoting model generation.
